abstract: PURPOSE: We established a cis-diamminedichloroplatinum (II) (CDDP) resistant cell line and determined the mechanisms of CDDP resistance. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The CDDP resistant cell line JKT/DDP was established from the highly metastatic human testicular seminoma cell line JKT-HM by long-term intermittent administration of low dose CDDP. Growth curves, CDDP sensitivity and intracellular CDDP concentrations were compared in JKT/DDP, the seminoma cell line JKT-1 and JKT-HM cells. Expression of the mRNA of MDR1, MRP, LRP and GST-pi was also compared. RESULTS: The growth curve and doubling time of JKT/DDP were similar to those of JKT-1 and JKT-HM in culture without CDDP but different with CDDP added to the culture. Morphologically cytoplasm segmentation and chromatin aggregation in JKT-1 and JKT-HM were observed when CDDP was present, while JKT/DDP cells were spindle-shaped and showed cobblestone growth. The IC50 for CDDP determined by the collagen gel drop embedded drug sensitivity test showed that JKT/DDP was more resistant to CDDP than the other 2 cell lines. The expression of MDR1, MRP and GST-pi was higher than in JKT-1 or JKT-HM cells and the intracellular CDDP concentration was lower in JKT/DDP. CONCLUSIONS: The JKT/DDP cell line acquired CDDP resistance by increased cytoplasmic CDDP metabolism.
abstract_ja:
目的：シスプラチン(CDDP)耐性細胞株を樹立し、耐性機序を明らかにすること。
方法：高転移性のヒト精巣セミノーマ細胞株JKT-HMに、低用量CDDPを長期間間欠的に投与して、CDDP耐性細胞株JKT/DDPを樹立した。増殖曲線、CDDP感受性、細胞内CDDP濃度を、JKT/DDP、セミノーマ細胞株JKT-1、JKT-HMで比較した。MDR1、MRP、LRP、GST-piのmRNA発現も比較した。
結果：JKT/DDPの増殖曲線と倍加時間は、CDDPを添加しない培養ではJKT-1およびJKT-HMと類似していたが、CDDP添加時には異なっていた。JKT-1およびJKT-HMでは、CDDP存在下で細胞質の分節化と染色質の凝集が観察されたが、JKT/DDPは紡錘形で敷石状に増殖した。コラーゲンゲル滴包埋薬剤感受性試験で求めたCDDPのIC50は、JKT/DDPが他の2株より高く、耐性であった。MDR1、MRP、GST-piの発現はJKT-1やJKT-HMより高く、JKT/DDPでは細胞内CDDP濃度が低かった。
結論：JKT/DDP細胞株は、細胞質内でのCDDP代謝の増加によりCDDP耐性を獲得した。
